articles.title: US ban on Canadian alcohol and dairy comes into effect as trade war drags on
articles.description: It is the latest escalation in the Canada-US trade war after negotiations collapsed in late August, with no word on when talks may resume.

articles.title: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
articles.description: Students are protesting over issues such as overcrowded classes, but the prime minister has condemned reports of violence.

articles.title: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
articles.description: Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.

articles.title: Bill Gates warns AI global framework talks harder than Cold War-era nuclear negotiations
articles.description: Microsoft founder Bill Gates has warned that getting countries to agree on a global framework for AI could be more difficult than Cold War-era negotiations to restrict nuclear weapons.

articles.title: Only diplomacy ​can solve conflict, says Iran after Trump rejects peace plan
articles.description: Iran has insisted that only diplomacy ​can solve its conflict with the US and Israel after Donald Trump said he rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait ‌of Hormuz and end the fighting.

articles.title: Spain housing crisis protest after 87-year-old woman evicted
articles.description: Tens of thousands of people marched through the streets of Madrid to protest against Spain's housing crisis after an 87-year-old woman was evicted from an apartment she had lived in for decades.
